ma.setTabBarStyle(Object object)

Dynamically set the overall style of tabBar.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
color String No Default color (hex color) of the text on the tab.
selectedColor String No Color (hex color) of the selected text on the tab.
backgroundColor String No Background color (hex color) of the tab.
borderStyle String No Border color of tabBar. Only black and white are supported.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

ma.setTabBarStyle({
  color: '#FF0000',
  selectedColor: '#00FF00',
  backgroundColor: '#0000FF',
  borderStyle: 'white'
});
